question: Which was the first state of India to adopt the Panchayati Raj system in the year 1959?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rajasthan** was the first state in India to adopt the Panchayati Raj system on 2nd October 1959.
 
• The Panchayati Raj system was inaugurated by the then Prime Minister of India, Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru, at Nagaur in Rajasthan.
